title: bug: an observe-path transient git failure wedges the delivery checkout BLOCKED with no recovery proof
description:
Found by worker-1b2cd09b on task-cab96ebcd3b6403cbbf412bdad839403. The following was read at HEAD cdca7094; no test reproduces it yet.

landOne (node-lander.ts:198) reports an observe GIT_FAILED without recording it and says "the next pass retries". In production that is false: repository-delivery-runtime.ts:120 returns RETRY only for GIT_INDEX_LOCKED, so repository-delivery-coordinator.ts:174 calls block(). BLOCKED has no transitions. Recovery needs either !everExecuted or a durable refusal receipt, and this path has neither, so the checkout is held forever and every later node is refused with REPOSITORY_EXECUTION_BUSY.

Parent row task-cab96ebc adds the RETRY edge for transient VERIFICATION codes. Extend that edge to the observe path once the parent lands; both rows edit the same land() line.

implementationPlan.description: TESTS FIRST / DoD 2-4. Before any source read, read authoritative DoD comment-ef7ce5f1071a4596928d9454fac244df and the parent's delivered verification/completion record from epicSiblings; dependsOn already prevents starting before that parent is DONE. Load test-driven-development and preserve foreign paths. Reuse the real fixture; add a named parameterized test 'retries observe %s failures without losing the accepted reservation' for an explicit nonempty ['status','hash-object'] case list. Capture real createGitLandingPort before vi.spyOn, then call through to it with a GitRunner that delegates every normal invocation to supplied runner ?? nodeGitRunner. Return a fixed nonzero result with marker OBSERVE_TRANSIENT_TEST only for the selected subprocess when armed. Never stub observe(), lander, coordinator, facts, receipt readers or authority. Start node a, change keep.txt, submit/retire, disableLanding and advance to genuine acceptance; snapshot original verifier receipt/tree, HEAD, landing aggregate, ownership/baseline/session and verification count. Arm only now, enableLanding, and drive two failed advances. Each pass must actually inject exactly once, emit '[lander] a: GIT_FAILED (OBSERVE_TRANSIENT_TEST)', retain ACCEPTED and AWAITING_LANDING with the same owner/baseline/session (not revision), keep HEAD/landing aggregate/accepted receipt unchanged, give exact {ok:false,code:'LANDING_RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND'} from readLandingReceipt, and leave readReviewLedgers(...).landingIntents empty. Assert node b's interim start returns {ok:false,code:'REPOSITORY_EXECUTION_BUSY',layer:'REPOSITORY_DELIVERY'}. Clear fault; next advance must produce COMMITTED receipt tied to the original verifier receipt and original verified tree, release the reservation, and keep test count at one. A further advance must leave HEAD and receipt aggregate unchanged; only then successfully start/await node b. Use finally for spy.mockRestore()/runtime.close() and existing fixture cleanup. Preserve existing parent/no-effect/post-intent test arms; strengthen their failure-stage assertions only if needed within this file. Run the narrow TDD command `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=30000 src/orchestrator/repository-delivery-runtime.test.ts -t "retries observe"`; capture RED at AWAITING_LANDING versus BLOCKED, not import/setup failure.

MINIMUM PRODUCTION FIX + DOCUMENTATION / DoD 1,4. In createRepositoryDeliveryRuntime's land callback add only the exact `report.outcome === "GIT_FAILED"` disjunct to the existing reports.some retry predicate; preserve GIT_INDEX_LOCKED and landingVerificationClass(report.outcome)==='TRANSIENT'. Update its inline why-comment: observe GIT_FAILED is read-only and reported before this attempt's landing intent/effect, so the existing coordinator may retain ACCEPTED work for a later pass; unknown/unsafe outcomes are not a default retry. Keep classifier/table, node-lander durable refusal rules, facts, coordinator states, retry cadence/bounds, recovery, logs and return/public shapes unchanged. Do not duplicate the verification roster or introduce a helper/constant for this single edge. Complete the documentation sweep by comparing the measured runbook next-pass promise with the implemented behavior; it is already correct, so record that finding in the step note and document the unchanged no-already-BLOCKED-repair scope there rather than edit unrelated docs. No migrations, new bridge, dependencies or files.

ONE CONSOLIDATED VERIFICATION GATE / DoD 2-4,6. Run fresh foreground from repository root, standalone legs with exact exit status (no pipes/semicolon chains or unmatched filters): (1) `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=30000 src/orchestrator/repository-delivery-runtime.test.ts src/orchestrator/node-lander.test.ts src/orchestrator/node-lander-verification.test.ts src/orchestrator/repository-delivery-coordinator.test.ts src/orchestrator/repository-delivery-recovery.test.ts src/orchestrator/repository-delivery-workflows.test.ts`; (2) `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck`; (3) `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` — THIS is the exact complete_task verification.command, require exit 0 and quote actual nonzero Test Files/Tests lines; (4) `pnpm typecheck`; (5) `pnpm test`; (6) `pnpm verify:foundation`; (7) `pnpm verify:store`; (8) `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`; (9) `pnpm test:e2e`. Root/app/e2e count lines must prove execution; name relevant production-integration and parent/post-intent/coordinator arms, never infer app coverage from root. This epic-final row owns the regression/integration and docs sweep; this is not an opt-in live-browser/provider/external-release proof. Use task-specific pre-diff merge-base baseline records and the delivered-tree run to attribute repo-wide failing paths; require owned daemon legs green and disclose foreign failures with exact paths/lines per global rail. If a baseline measurement is missing, obtain it without altering the shared checkout or creating a sibling worktree; no invented baseline. Acquire any required full-suite resource only immediately before execution, announce bounded ETA/GATE START, settle all children, publish GATE END/counts and release it. Windows/macOS/Linux: invoke host pnpm as foreground executable with argv arrays if scripted; no hard-coded pnpm.cmd/shell:true wrappers. Gate corrections stay in the two owned files; rerun this gate after any resulting source changes.

ONE ADVERSARIAL REVIEW + NON-VACUITY / DoD 1,4,5. Load adversarial-self-review and review the complete two-file diff as an attacker: repeated/concurrent advance must not duplicate landing; initial baseline/verification failure must not stand in for observe; missing receipt is not landing authority; existing post-intent/restart fences and structural refusal remain unchanged; reservation revision may move but ownership must not; retries are still unbounded per later pass and already-BLOCKED records are not repaired. Use a process-local Vite transform with an exact-one-match guard to remove ONLY the new raw-GIT_FAILED predicate disjunct, then run the committed 'retries observe' cases: require executed cases and semantic RED expected AWAITING_LANDING/received BLOCKED, quoting exact output in a row comment. The mutation must not drop the parent's verification branch or test code. Keep full temporary config source in a <4500-character comment if needed for recreation; do not commit probes/evidence files. Prefer no disk mutation; if unavoidable first inspect exact paths and save live bytes outside tree under task+worker+nonce, record pre-mutation SHA256, restore from that fresh backup, and independently prove restored live hash equals prehash in a separate call, never via git restore or bare diff. Never drill a file another leased suite is reading. Confirm ordinary source bytes remain the verified ones, capture git diff --check and exact touched-path ownership, and report original-red/green/mutant-red plus gate counts and unchanged-scope limitations in durable completion evidence. No new implementation or security/evidence row; actual unresolved own-path defects are fixed here and sent back through the consolidated gate.

AUTHORITATIVE DoD AMENDMENT for task-65a594816ed5460f999fbd46f40c5cea. This comment REPLACES the placeholder definitionOfDone field ("Task completed as described") for implementation and QA grading. Human confirmed the proposed two-file approach with "continue" in the REPL on 2026-09-11. No retry-budget feature, recovery API, or repair/migration of already-BLOCKED reservations is authorized. Keep dependsOn task-cab96ebcd3b6403cbbf412bdad839403; its current resource BLOCKED/checkpoints are not delivery.

1. Production createRepositoryDeliveryRuntime translates the lander's exact raw observe GIT_FAILED report into RETRY, preserving the existing GIT_INDEX_LOCKED branch and landingVerificationClass(...)=TRANSIENT branch unchanged. It introduces no broad default/string-prefix retry, no second verification roster, no new receipt/code/shape, and no coordinator/recovery/state-machine edit. One attempt per advance; retries remain unbounded across passes.

2. Committed tests in repository-delivery-runtime.test.ts reach REAL SQLite/Git, verifier acceptance, node-lander, observe port, runtime and coordinator. Inject only a GitRunner status/hash-object subprocess failure through a call-through createGitLandingPort spy, armed AFTER genuine acceptance. Both cases must actually execute (explicit case list and per-case call count), report exact GIT_FAILED at the [lander] observe stage, and retain the same reservation ownership/baseline/session in AWAITING_LANDING for two failed passes. Assert ACCEPTED, original verifier receipt, one verification, unchanged HEAD and landing aggregate, exact LANDING_RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND, and empty landing-intent set. Raw observe/receipt-read results do not have a layer field: pin their actual stage rather than fabricate one.

3. While awaiting retry, starting node b returns exact REPOSITORY_EXECUTION_BUSY with layer REPOSITORY_DELIVERY. Clear the injected fault; the next advance commits node a's ORIGINAL verified tree and durable COMMITTED receipt referencing the ORIGINAL verifier receipt, then releases the reservation. Another advance creates neither a second commit nor another receipt, and node b can subsequently acquire the checkout. Restore the spy and close runtime/fixture resources even on assertion failure.

4. Preserve the parent verification-retry arm and existing no-effect/post-intent protections. At the delivered tree, run the existing runtime arm "re-queues a transient capture failure and lands the same acceptance once the moment passes", its "keeps a refusal that already journaled an intent in the REFUSED bucket and still blocks" arm, node-lander tests, verification table census, and coordinator arm "blocks accepted work when landing has no durable outcome". NOT_A_REPOSITORY remains the lander's durable structural refusal; unknown/unsafe/post-effect reports gain no new RETRY edge. The current runbook docs/agent-stack-runbook.md already promises GIT_FAILED retry next pass; implement that promise without claiming existing BLOCKED checkouts recover.

5. Non-vacuity: a process-local mutation removing ONLY the newly added raw-GIT_FAILED retry disjunct makes the committed observe regression red at expected AWAITING_LANDING versus received BLOCKED. Quote the exact failure and executed-case counts. Prefer an in-memory Vite transform; any physical drill must use task+worker+nonce backup, record live pre-mutation SHA256, restore that copy, and prove the live hash equals the original in a separate call. No git restore/reset and no mutations during another leased suite.

6. Final evidence command is pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test, fresh foreground exit 0 with its actual nonzero Test Files/Tests count lines. Also run daemon typecheck and the required root gates (pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm verify:foundation, pnpm verify:store), explicit @moe/control-room test, and pnpm test:e2e for this epic-final row. Root tests do not cover apps. Record baseline-vs-delivered failing-path attribution for repo-wide legs per global rail, disclose foreign red exactly, and require owned daemon legs exit 0; never count unmatched filters/zero-test runs as execution. Complete the epic-final docs/integration and adversarial sweep in this row, not another evidence task.
